verdict.rationale: Global Catalog MCP explicitly supports keyless/anonymous cross-merchant search — 'Cart tools accept unauthenticated requests' and the trust-tier doc confirms an Anonymous tier exists alongside Token/Signed, so no private partnership is required to search. However, every request must include a UCP agent profile (self-service but a real setup step), rate limits are lowest for anonymous/keyless access, and richer features (personalized search, higher limits) require identification tiers, meaning fully keyless discovery is functional but constrained. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that anonymous search actually works in practice (only claimed-docs), and clearer detail on how limited anonymous-tier search results are versus Token-tier.
